Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood <> BrightCart — VP/CTO intro to unblock next steps

Hi Laura / Mark — thanks again for the 30-minute demo earlier today. Quick recap + proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

Recap from today's call:
- BrightCart is evaluating Redwood for low-latency checkout personalization + product description generation (throughput ~ 60 req/s peak, typical 300–600 token responses).
- Key constraints: PCI-adjacent data handling, regional isolation (US), and predictable latency under 90ms p95.
- Current pilot ask: 2-week POC, integrated into a single service with token-level cost tracking and rollback-safe deploys.

Proposed next steps to unblock pilot:
1) VP/CTO alignment call (Rajiv + your CTO) — high level on SLAs, network/KMS requirements, and pilot runway acceptance criteria.
2) Technical deep dive / demo (SE + infra walkthrough) — walk through runtime, caching, quantization options, and sample throughput tests.

Suggested attendees:
- BrightCart: Rajiv Patel (VP Eng), Laura Chen (CTO), one infra engineer
- Redwood: Karthik Iyer (AE), Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng), Ben Carter (Customer Success)

Open slots I have available (feel free to pick any or propose alternatives):
- Tue Jun 22, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed Jun 23, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Thu Jun 24, 09:30–10:15 PT

If it helps, here's my calendar link to pick a time: https://calendly.com/soojin-lee/30 

I attached a very short technical agenda for the deep dive (1 page) and an internal demo runbook we'll use on Redwood's side.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a VP/CTO handshake so we can schedule the deep dive the same week.

Best,

--
